resize-sidebar.settings.enableSidebarRes: Show a drag handle on the inner edge of the sidebar to set its width. Your width is remembered on this device.
resize-sidebar.settings.enableChatResize: Show a drag handle on the top edge of the chat input to set its height. Your height is remembered on this device.
resize-sidebar.settings.enableWindowResi: Make popped-out sidebar windows (Combat Tracker, Playlists, directories, etc.) resizable. Takes effect after a reload.
resize-sidebar.settings.enableAVResize.h: Show a drag handle on the inner edge of the audio/video camera dock to set its size (width or height depending on where it is docked). Your size is remembered on this device.
